provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Each original captured molecule independently receives one of B barcodes uniformly before amplification. All occupied barcodes are detected at least once and reads of the same barcode are collapsed; there is no sequencing error, barcode bias or library cross-talk. Amplification can produce any positive read multiplicity and is not an independent molecule counter.
estimator: Use the occupancy moment E[U|M]=B*(1-(1-1/B)^M). Invert it at observed U to obtain a REAL-VALUED method-of-moments estimate. Do not round it into an exact count or call it a maximum-likelihood estimator. The occupancy is stochastic, so inversion does not identify the actual realized original M.
scope: Controlled measurement-count collision correction, not a wet-lab design or a claim of complete recovery of unobserved organisms.
